set_info.convention: pose_arc.py: lat 0 = source posterior (AP), +90 = source patient-left (RAO family), -90 = source patient-right (the real Surgio lateral); tilt + = beam cranial; no jitter, no wander

denominator: per (lat, tilt) cell: projected boxes with inside >= 0.25 pooled over 40 subjects; boxes below are ignored (not FPs), matching greedy descending-confidence at IoU >= 0.5 (realxray_eval conventions)
falloff_rule: smallest |lat| where recall first drops below 0.9 x recall(lat 0), per curve
